tools.exec_command({cmd:"uv run --with pymupdf --with shapely python /Users/hushili/.codex/skills/outpatient-plan-annotation/scripts/annotation_tools.py validate 'p-写作过程/标注试样/39_梅州市蕉岭县人民医院/annotation.json' --check-dir","max_output_tokens":1800}),
tools.exec_command({cmd:"python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json,hashlib,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root=Path('p-写作过程/标注试样/39_梅州市蕉岭县人民医院')
d=json.loads((root/'annotation.json').read_text())
sha=hashlib.sha256((root/d['image']['file']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha=='d16318fc52e9c69cda1f4d045cd15f0915378cd63d01dbb05a39079a72c785d4'
assert set(d)=={'image','spaces','relations'}
assert len(list(root.iterdir()))==4
svg=ET.parse(root/'标注.svg').getroot(); ns={'s':'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
byid={g.get('id'):g for g in svg.findall('.//s:g',ns) if g.get('id','').startswith('S')}
assert len(byid)==len(d['spaces'])
for s in d['spaces']:
 g=byid[s['id']];shown=''.join(g.itertext())
 visible=''.join(t.text or '' for t in g.findall('s:text',ns))
 assert s['id'] in visible
 assert s['name'] in visible, (s['id'],visible)
 got=[tuple(map(float,q.split(','))) for q in g.find('s:polygon',ns).get('points').split()]
 expected=[(y,round(2424-x,3)) for x,y in s['polygon_px']]
 assert got==expected, s['id']
reviews=json.loads(Path('/tmp/outpatient39-review/review_layout_check.json').read_text())
assert reviews[0]['items']==[f'{i:02d}' for i in range(1,40)]
assert all(not r['crossings'] for r in reviews)
for r in reviews:
 for z in r['placements']:
  assert 50<z['label'][1]<r['size'][1]-100
 for side in [True,False]:
  ys=[z['label'][1] for z in r['placements'] if (z['label'][0]<1000)==side]
  assert all(b-a>=111.9 for a,b in zip(ys,ys[1:])), (r['file'],ys)
mapdata=json.loads(Path('/tmp/outpatient39-review/review_mapping.json').read_text())
assert {s['id'] for s in mapdata}=={s['id'] for s in d['spaces'] if s['type']=='unknown'}
report=dict(files={p.name:p.stat().st_size for p in root.iterdir()},source_sha256=sha,spaces=len(d['spaces']),pending=len(mapdata),area_ratio_sum=sum(s.get('area_ratio',0) for s in d['spaces']),relation_types=dict(Counter(r['type'] for r in d['relations'])),svg_visible_ids_and_names='107/107',review_images=len(reviews),review_crossings=0)
Path('/tmp/outpatient39-review/最终草稿检查.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY","max_output_tokens":2200})
